notes: QuantumCanary is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 CANARY once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no transfer fees, further minting or administrative privileges. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs CANARY with IMD. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
